result.title: LongSCOP: Semantically Consistent Long Video Outpainting
result.summary: Video out-painting is an important problem, yet existing research focuses primarily on short clips, leaving long video out-painting largely underexplored. Extending video out-painting to long videos poses substantial challenges. A natural solution is iterative out-painting, i.e., generating videos chunk by chunk, but this introduces two major issues: generation instability or even failure caused by inter-chunk inconsistencies and error accumulation, and semantic drift over long temporal horizons. In this paper, we propose LongSCOP, short for Semantically Consistent long Video Out-Painting. First, we introduce a training recipe with three components for smooth and stable long-horizon generation: self-forcing training, latent calibration, and future references. Beyond generation stability, we recognize that the rich temporal context of long videos provides valuable references for maintaining semantic consistency. We therefore develop a VLM-based agent that automatically selects the most informative reference frames from the entire video to maintain consistent subjects, scenes, and backgrounds throughout long-horizon generation. We also construct a high-quality training dataset of 62K video clips. To facilitate research on this underexplored problem, we introduce LVO-Bench, a benchmark curated by human experts to assess long-horizon stability and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both generation stability and semantic coherence.

AI.brief_summary: LongSCOP 研究长视频外扩：采用分块迭代生成，并提出含 self-forcing 训练、latent calibration 与未来参考帧的训练方案以抑制块间不一致和误差累积，同时用 VLM 智能体从全片自动挑选信息量最大的参考帧维持主体与场景一致，另构建 62K 视频片段数据和 LVO-Bench 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 任务是视频外扩生成而非多模态推理，但其「VLM 智能体筛选参考帧」的视觉证据选择机制和 latent calibration 对长时语义漂移的约束，可能为 LVR 中的证据获取与隐状态漂移控制提供可供核查的线索。
